# Integrating tom_som_dart_v0

<!-- GENERATED by tom_specs_clitool generate_som — do not edit by hand. -->

`tom_som_dart_v0` is the typed TomSpecs object-model facade for Dart. It depends on `tom_som_dart_runtime`. Both are versioned to the TomSpecs **model version** (currently `1.0.0`) — pin to that version so your document reads and writes match the model the facade was generated from.

## Quick start

Add `tom_som_dart_v0` to your `pubspec.yaml` (`dart pub add tom_som_dart_v0`), then:

```dart
import 'package:tom_som_dart_v0/tom_som_dart_v0.dart';

void main() {
  // A typed Solution Blueprint over a fresh document.
  final doc = SpecDocument();
  final blueprint = D00SolutionBlueprint(doc);

  blueprint.content = 'A platform that unifies our fragmented order systems.';
  blueprint.currentLandscape.content =
      'Three legacy systems with no shared customer record.';

  print(blueprint.content);
}
```

## Dependency routes

### From pub.dev

Add the dependency and let pub resolve it:

```bash
dart pub add tom_som_dart_v0
```

or pin it explicitly in `pubspec.yaml`:

```yaml
dependencies:
  tom_som_dart_v0: ^VERSION
```

### Git dependency

Depend on the package directly from source control:

```yaml
dependencies:
  tom_som_dart_v0:
    git:
      url: https://github.com/al-the-bear/tom_ai_build.git
      path: tom_som_dart_v0
```

### Path dependency (monorepo / vendored)

When the SOM projects sit alongside your package, depend by path:

```yaml
dependencies:
  tom_som_dart_v0:
    path: ../tom_som_dart_v0
```

## Pinning the version

Both `tom_som_dart_runtime` and `tom_som_dart_v0` carry version `1.0.0`, taken from the TomSpecs model version. When you upgrade the model, regenerate and move to the new matching version so the facade and your stored documents stay in step.

## Building from source

Regenerate the facade and dry-run the package from the workspace:

```bash
dart run tom_specs_clitool/bin/generate_som.dart
cd tom_som_dart_v0 && dart pub get && dart pub publish --dry-run
```
